decisions.rationale: Copy comes from the checked source inventory and source-file SHA-256.
Only tags and events recorded in the source inventory are represented; unlabelled actions remain unlabelled.
Storefront follows Soft Modern tokens; admin keeps its separate staff palette; shared primitive host appearance stays caller-owned.
The source inventory does not define the complete layout geometry for this independent component board.
Vazirmatn is used for readable Persian UI/body copy in design-board images.

The board renderer uses the locally bundled Estedad SemiBold. Admin source tokens already name Estedad as display; for web, Estedad is a licensed proposed substitute for the Peyda display role. This is image-only and does not revise app typography.

decisions.property: Interactive app behavior and exact runtime geometry
decisions.rationale: The live app was not operated; renderer rectangles are measured only within this proposed image.
